assertions: Two triggers for the same schedule revision and nominal firing time returned the same immutable firing record and canonical submission.
A default execution-route change after schedule creation did not redirect the replayed firing.
Only one firing record was stored and no worker attempt was created by admission or replay.
limitations: This contract test uses in-memory providers; PostgreSQL restart, competing timer owners, DST, misfire, catch-up, overlap, revision transfer, and native-trigger rejection fixtures remain open.
